clinc150.note: Re-measured 27 Sep 2026 with published @ruvector/typesafe 0.1.0 (bge-small ONNX). 8-shot: every 3rd of 4,500 in-scope test items + all 1,000 out-of-scope. Zero-shot: all 5,500. The earlier 0.50 came from the harness at 5356a84, which left in-scope items unflagged (fixed upstream in 8825933a).

previous.note: CLINC150, 8 shots/intent, first 1,500 in-scope test items + 150 out-of-scope. OOS release gate (AUROC >= 0.85) fails: abstain mass is ~0 everywhere.
